description: «Add members» on an import (a plan or a finished one): an account in this company for each named Jira account of the import, at the address Jira shows — a member, put on the imported project, matched to that Jira account, with no invitation and no password (they sign in with Google or a code to that address). 'notify' (off by default) sends each person made exactly one letter that they were added. Where Jira hid an address, 'emails' gives the person's real one; 'matchMembers' says which of those addresses belong to a member already and are to be matched rather than made. Only the import's own people: an address somebody outside the company holds is never taken over. Each account made is a line in the company's journal. Answers per account with its 'outcome' (created; member — matched to a member who has that address; memberFound — a typed address is a member's, say matchMembers; noEmail — Jira hid it, give it in emails; hasAccount / taken — the address is held outside the company, invite that person; noSeat — past the plan's seats; unknown — not this import's), how many were made and mailed, and 'rewritten' — what was put on them on a finished import. The company's administrator only.

accounts.description: Jira account ids from get_import's plan.people, as 'acc-1, acc-2'.

emails.description: Addresses for people whose address Jira hid, as 'acc-3=carl@acme.example'.

matchMembers.description: Of 'emails', the accounts whose address is a member's already, to be matched to that member, as 'acc-3'.

notify.description: True to send each person made one letter. Off by default.
